summary: Exfiltrates /profile response to hardcoded webhook.site endpoint on load
details: index.js executes on require/import and issues fetch('/profile'), then forwards the response body as a URL-encoded query parameter to the hardcoded anonymous request-capture endpoint https://webhook.site/cf4d1f39-0404-4703-8944-105e33c1ec5f/. The destination is an attacker-controlled webhook.site collector unrelated to any declared publisher or purpose; the package ships as a stub with placeholder manifest metadata and no documented functionality. Loading the module in a context where a relative /profile endpoint exists (e.g., a browser page or same-origin app) causes user/session profile data to be transmitted to the third-party collector.

cwes.description: The product contains code that appears to be malicious in nature.
cwes.name: Embedded Malicious Code
